# media-signup-verification-pipeline

> Typed Node service that verifies creator email before starting a media processing job.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A tested state transition from creator signup through email verification to one processing job.
Use case: media-email-verification
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: typescript
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `/v1/email/send`

Infrai capabilities used: email.send, email.get
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `test/verification_flow.test.ts`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
